mainEntity.name: What is SatvaStones jewellery made of?

acceptedAnswer.text: Materials and finishes vary by product. Check the details on the product page or contact us before ordering.

mainEntity.name: Can I wear it around water?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check the care information for your specific piece. If you are unsure whether a finish is suitable for water exposure, contact us.

mainEntity.name: How should I store my jewellery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Store pieces separately in a dry place and follow the care information supplied for your product.
